title: The Last Archive
author: Theo Marchetti
blurb: Elodie Ashgrove, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
